about: Signal City's sprite style sheet as data (WISHLIST.md B1). validate.mjs reads it; cars.py reads ppm, pad and the sheet. ppm is pixels per metre in the sheet: a frame is ceil(length * ppm) + 2 * pad by ceil(width * ppm) + 2 * pad, the canvas spriteFor() makes. spriteFrom and spriteTo are the band of spriteFor's own pixels per metre in which B3 draws a frame from the sheet; outside it the procedural car. states is how many frames an archetype has per palette where it is not 1. maxKiB is KiB x 1024, maxSide the longest side in pixels, minCoverage the share of a frame's pixels at alpha 128 or more below which the frame is taken for empty or half-built.
